emotional_tone: Editorial, sophisticated, intellectual, organic yet highly structured

tech_stack.css: Tailwind CSS via CDN or build step (no React/Shadcn)

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant - classic serif for dramatic impact, paired with an ultra-clean geometric sans for structure.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[8vw] font-light tracking-tighter leading-[0.9]

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Never center-align body text. Keep left-aligned for an editorial flow.
Use italics in serif headings to highlight specific words (e.g., 'The Science of Art').
White/Black provide the stark structural contrast.
Forest Green is used for interaction states, active lines, and the Science section.
Lavender is used for soft backgrounds, Music section highlights, and hover blooms.
No generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with high contrast.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous. Use massive padding between sections (py-32 md:py-48) to create breathing room.
layouts.grid: Use 12-column CSS Grid. Do not center everything. Offset content. e.g., text spans col 2-6, image spans col 8-12.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-black/10 for dividing sections or creating 'bento' structural frames.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the screen (opacity 0.03) to kill the 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.images: Use sharp, un-rounded corners (0px radius) for photos to maintain the editorial print-design aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.header: Solid or heavy-blur glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAFAFA]/80) with a 1px bottom border. DO NOT USE FULLY TRANSPARENT HEADERS if scrolling over content.

sections_blueprint.name: Header & Nav
sections_blueprint.layout: Fixed top, flex justify-between, minimal. Logo left, Nav links right.
sections_blueprint.features: Must have a solid or blurred background so links are readable over scrolling content.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero (Kinetic)
sections_blueprint.layout: Massive typographic statement. Split into 2 or 3 lines.
sections_blueprint.features: Signature GSAP on-load text reveal using clip-path or y-translation with overflow-hidden wrappers. Subtle 3D mouse parallax on a background element.

sections_blueprint.name: Bio (About)
sections_blueprint.layout: Asymmetrical. Left: text block with large drop-cap. Right: Deliberately treated photography (spotlight/clipped frame).

sections_blueprint.name: Marquee Divider
sections_blueprint.layout: Full width, overflow hidden, massive outlined text (text-8xl text-transparent border-black).

sections_blueprint.name: Music (Audio Player)
sections_blueprint.layout: Minimalist tracklist layout. High contrast (maybe dark surface #0A0A0A with Lavender accents).
sections_blueprint.features: Custom HTML/JS audio player. Use minimalist play/pause icons (SVG). Hovering a track reveals a subtle lavender bloom or image.

sections_blueprint.name: Science (Blog/Manifesto)
sections_blueprint.layout: Numbered manifesto chapters. Massive numbers (01, 02) paired with short articles.
sections_blueprint.features: Use Forest Green for the numbers or hover states. Staggered fade-in on scroll.

sections_blueprint.name: Contact (Footer)
sections_blueprint.layout: Massive 'Let's Talk' typography (text-[10vw]). Simple Formspree HTML form.
sections_blueprint.features: Form inputs must be minimalist (bottom borders only, no background). Form submit button in Forest Green.

motion.scrolling: Initialize Lenis globally for buttery smooth momentum.
motion.hero_reveal: gsap.from() with y: '100%', ease: 'power4.out', stagger: 0.1, duration: 1.5, wrapped in overflow-hidden spans.
motion.scroll_reveals: Use GSAP ScrollTrigger. Elements fade in and translate up (y: 40, opacity: 0) as they enter viewport.
motion.micro_interactions: Custom cursor (optional), magnetic buttons using GSAP, smooth image scaling on hover (scale: 1.05 within hidden overflow container).
motion.page_transitions: A full-screen black overlay that slides up on DOMContentLoaded before revealing the hero.

bio_portrait.description: Contemplative black and white portrait of a woman, for the Bio section.

science_background.description: Moody dark green foliage to use as a parallax accent or image mask in the Science section.

music_accent.description: Soft lavender abstract floral background to use alongside the Music player or hover states.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images or colored backgrounds passes WCAG AA. Use text-shadow or overlays if needed.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, play toggles) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling GSAP animations if true.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a STATIC site. DO NOT scaffold a React/Next.js app. Create an index.html, style.css, and app.js.
Import Tailwind via CDN script for styling.
Import GSAP, ScrollTrigger, and Lenis via CDN.
Load fonts from Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond and Outfit.
Follow the exact color hex codes provided.
Do NOT use placeholder images from dummyimage.com; use the exact Pexels URLs provided in 'image_urls'.
Ensure the Formspree form is fully functional standard HTML form (<form action='https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_ENDPOINT' method='POST'>).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use extreme asymmetrical padding, massive typography contrasts, and intentional negative space.
Never center-align the main app container.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp editorial buttons. Avoid generic rounded-md blue bootstrap-style buttons.
No AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) anywhere.
All interactions must have a hover state.
Implement real scroll physics via Lenis.
